answer: A willow survives the storm because it bends, and a ballot should prove it can bend too. Mid-epoch, behind a velvet curtain, the protocol swaps one challenge word and drops a fresh ridge line at a random minute. Every ballot gets ten minutes to answer the new word, hashing it with its own id. A farm's 10,000 scripts keep reciting the stale words and miss the window: all 10,000 forfeit a $25 bond, $250,000 gone, and staffing 10,000 live watchers takes 500 operators times six hours at $15 an hour, $45,000 a tide. The willow bends and keeps its vote; the script snaps and pays.
